evidence: PV_P: its source F2 has no enable pin and the board declares neither a switch nor that the rail is always on
TRK_OUT: the board declares U5 as its switch and that part has no enable pin in the netlist
PV_IN: it is a segment of PV_P and PV_P is itself unresolved, so the segment is too
note: each rail's enable derived from the netlist and the part that drives it named; a rail whose enable is driven only by a device powered from that same rail cannot start and is a failure. The ORDER between rails is reported as the graph and not decided here, because which order is correct is a property of the modules' own datasheets
